gloss: to mince, to chop; to carve, to engrave

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {刻|きざ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To cut food into small pieces.
To cut or etch a design, pattern, or letters into a hard surface.
For time to pass moment by moment.

notes:
{刻|きざ}む has two main meanings: cutting food finely, and carving/engraving.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刻|きざ}む

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{刻|きざ}む (to chop finely)
- ⟦{時|とき}→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刻|きざ}む (to tick away time)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻|きざ}む (to engrave in one's heart, to remember deeply)
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻|きざ}む (to be recorded in history)
